name: perk-wallet
description: Open-source web3 crypto wallet platform with PerkLock time-locked asset vaults.

scripts.dev: npm run build:perklock && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:perklock && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace frontend
